name: Mumbai
description: Coastal megacity highly vulnerable to tidal surges, Mithi river backflow, and heavy monsoon downpours.
historicalHotspot: Hindmata, Milan Subway, Kurla West, Dharavi

wards.name: Hindmata & Parel (Ward F/South)
wards.criticalInfrastructure: KEM Hospital, Tata Memorial, Lalbaug Flyover
wards.recommendedAction: Deploy 5000 GPM high-capacity dewatering pumps, divert Dr. Ambedkar Road traffic, barricade underpasses.

wards.name: Dharavi & Sion (Ward G/North)
wards.criticalInfrastructure: Sion Railway Station, Central Line Tracks, Transit Camps
wards.recommendedAction: Early evacuation of ground floors along Mithi buffer, pre-position NDRF rubberized rescue boats.

wards.name: Kurla West & LBS Marg (Ward L)
wards.criticalInfrastructure: Kurla Terminus (CR/Harbour), Bail Bazar Substation
wards.recommendedAction: Monitor Mithi river gauge at Kranti Nagar, sound local siren, shut down sub-station if water reaches 0.5m.

wards.name: Milan Subway & Santacruz (Ward H/East)
wards.criticalInfrastructure: Western Express Highway (WEH) Underpass, Airport South Gate
wards.recommendedAction: Activate automated boom-barriers at subway entry, engage dual standby storm pumps.

wards.name: Andheri Subway & SV Road (Ward K/West)
wards.criticalInfrastructure: Andheri Railway Station West, Metro Line 1 interchange
wards.recommendedAction: Close subway traffic early, redirect vehicles via Gokhale Bridge, clear Mogra Nullah trash racks.

wards.name: Bandra-Kurla Complex (Ward H/East)
wards.criticalInfrastructure: NSE, MCA, US Consulate, Bharat Diamond Bourse
wards.recommendedAction: Operate flap gates at Vakola Nullah; ensure basement parking sump pumps are operational.

wards.name: Malad Subway & Marve Link (Ward P/North)
wards.criticalInfrastructure: Malad Station West, Inorbit Mall Link Road
wards.recommendedAction: Monitor Malad creek tidal levels, pre-position mobile diesel pumps.

name: Guwahati
description: Valley city bound by the Brahmaputra River and surrounded by steep hill slopes causing flash runoff and localized urban ponding.
historicalHotspot: Anil Nagar, Nabin Nagar, Zoo Road, Hatigaon

wards.name: Anil Nagar & Nabin Nagar (Ward 24)
wards.criticalInfrastructure: Chandmari Junction, Gauhati Commerce College
wards.recommendedAction: Turn on Bharalumukh sluice gate super-pumps, establish SDRF boat stations on Rajgarh Road.

wards.name: Zoo Road & R.G. Baruah (Ward 21)
wards.criticalInfrastructure: State Zoo Entrance, GMCH Link Road
wards.recommendedAction: Clear sediment and trash screens along hill nullahs, alert traffic police for one-way diversions.

wards.name: Hatigaon & Sijubari (Ward 30)
wards.criticalInfrastructure: Capital Complex South Link, Sub-division Office
wards.recommendedAction: Issue flash alert to ground-floor residents, deploy emergency power generators for water extraction.

wards.name: Dispur Secretariat & Last Gate (Ward 27)
wards.criticalInfrastructure: Assam State Secretariat, Legislative Assembly
wards.recommendedAction: Maintain open arterial exits, clear drainage outfalls toward Basistha river.

wards.name: Fancy Bazar & Panbazar (Ward 15)
wards.criticalInfrastructure: Kamrup Metro DC Office, Railway Main Station
wards.recommendedAction: Inspect river sluice gates against Brahmaputra backflow; prevent riverward stormwater blockages.

wards.name: Maligaon & Jalukbari (Ward 04)
wards.criticalInfrastructure: Northeast Frontier Railway HQ, Guwahati University Bypass
wards.recommendedAction: Deploy silt excavators along Pandu outfall canal; caution road users on NH27 junction.

name: Kochi
description: Island and coastal city surrounded by Vembanad Lake, tidal canals, and sensitive backwaters prone to high-tide flood synergy.
historicalHotspot: MG Road, Kaloor, Edappally, Aluva, West Kochi

wards.name: MG Road & Shenoys (Division 62)
wards.criticalInfrastructure: Kochi Metro Corridor, Ernakulam South Rly Station
wards.recommendedAction: Activate Mullassery canal pumps, barricade inundated shop entrances, divert bus traffic.

wards.name: Kaloor & JNI Stadium (Division 67)
wards.criticalInfrastructure: Kaloor Private Bus Stand, Kaloor Metro Station, 110kV Substation
wards.recommendedAction: Inspect drainage along Perandoor canal; place sandbag barriers around KSEB transformers.

wards.name: Edappally Toll & Canal (Division 35)
wards.criticalInfrastructure: LuLu Mall Junction, NH66-NH544 Interchange
wards.recommendedAction: Deploy quick-response teams along Edappally canal outfalls to Vembanad; monitor tidal surge.

wards.name: West Kochi & Mattancherry (Division 05)
wards.criticalInfrastructure: Cochin Port Link, Mattancherry Wharf, Heritage Quarters
wards.recommendedAction: Check tidal warning schedule; set up relief shelters on higher ground in Fort Kochi.

wards.name: Aluva Town & Periyar Bank (Greater Kochi)
wards.criticalInfrastructure: Aluva Shiva Temple ground, Aluva Water Treatment Plant (serves 1M+)
wards.recommendedAction: Coordinate with KSEB dam discharge warnings from Idukki/Bhoothathankettu; protect pump houses.

wards.name: Kalamassery & Premier (Division 41)
wards.criticalInfrastructure: CUSAT University, Kalamassery Industrial Belt
wards.recommendedAction: Use designated high grounds as transit staging centers for West Kochi evacuees.

name: Dehradun
description: Doon Valley hill city prone to rapid torrential flash floods along Rispana and Bindal river corridors.
historicalHotspot: Rispana Pul, Patel Nagar, Kargi Chowk, Sahastradhara Road

wards.name: Rispana River Corridor (Ward 32)
wards.criticalInfrastructure: Rispana Bridge, Bypass Link, Kathbangla Slum
wards.recommendedAction: Issue immediate flash flood alarm via community sirens; initiate preventive evacuation within 100m of river.

wards.name: Bindal River & Patel Nagar (Ward 28)
wards.criticalInfrastructure: ISBT Link Road, Patel Nagar Police Station, Bindal Bridge
wards.recommendedAction: Barricade low-level bridges along Bindal river, deploy State Disaster Response Force (SDRF) teams.

wards.name: Paltan Bazar & Clock Tower (Ward 14)
wards.criticalInfrastructure: Central Commercial Hub, Dehradun Railway Station North
wards.recommendedAction: Clear roadside stormwater grates to prevent flash sheets of water rushing down Rajpur slope.

wards.name: Sahastradhara Road Corridor (Ward 40)
wards.criticalInfrastructure: IT Park, Helipad, Tourism Highway
wards.recommendedAction: Monitor hill nullah runoff debris; position earthmovers for rapid landslide/debris removal.

wards.name: Kargi Chowk & Mothrowala (Ward 55)
wards.criticalInfrastructure: Sewage Treatment Plant, Haridwar Bypass
wards.recommendedAction: Reinforce vulnerable river training walls, alert agricultural pockets against crop submergence.

wards.name: Rajpur Road & Dalanwala (Ward 08)
wards.criticalInfrastructure: Collectorate, Secretariat Annexes
wards.recommendedAction: Primary staging area for disaster relief and emergency ambulance movement.

name: Chennai
description: Coastal metropolis on the Coromandel coast drained by Adyar and Cooum rivers and Buckingham canal; extreme Northeast Monsoon risk.
historicalHotspot: Velachery, Mudichur, T. Nagar, Saidapet, Vyasarpadi

wards.name: Velachery & Madipakkam (Zone 13/14)
wards.criticalInfrastructure: Velachery MRTS Station, Phoenix Market City, Bypass Junction
wards.recommendedAction: Pre-stage SDRF and Army boats at Velachery Lake bund; activate heavy diesel surplus pumps.

wards.name: Mudichur & Tambaram West (South Zone)
wards.criticalInfrastructure: Tambaram Railway Hub, Outer Ring Road Entry, GST Road Link
wards.recommendedAction: Immediate evacuation warning for Varadharajapuram & Mudichur residential sectors.

wards.name: T. Nagar & Usman Road (Zone 10)
wards.criticalInfrastructure: Usman Road Flyover, Panagal Park, Commercial Shopping Spine
wards.recommendedAction: Clear Smart City stormwater drain inlets; cut off low-level electrical feeder pillars.

wards.name: Saidapet & Maraimalai Adigal Bridge (Zone 09)
wards.criticalInfrastructure: Saidapet Metro Station, Adyar River Bridge, Kalaignar Centenary Hospital
wards.recommendedAction: Track Chembarambakkam reservoir outflow; issue riverside clearance alert 6 hours prior to discharge peak.

wards.name: Vyasarpadi & Perambur (Zone 04)
wards.criticalInfrastructure: Perambur Loco Works, Basin Bridge Junction, GNT Road
wards.recommendedAction: Deploy heavy suction tankers along Ganesapuram subway; shift vulnerable slum dwellers to community halls.

wards.name: Mylapore & Foreshore Estate (Zone 09)
wards.criticalInfrastructure: Santhome Cathedral, Marina Beach Arterial Road
wards.recommendedAction: Monitor sea swell and high tide overlap with Buckingham canal tidal gates.

name: Patna
description: Linear city sandwiched between the Ganga and Punpun rivers with saucer-shaped lowlands below the high flood level of surrounding rivers.
historicalHotspot: Rajendra Nagar, Kankarbagh, Boring Road, Badshahpur Nala

wards.name: Rajendra Nagar (Ward 40/41)
wards.criticalInfrastructure: Rajendra Nagar Terminal, Nalanda Medical College, Substation
wards.recommendedAction: Run all 6 pumps at Saidpur drainage sump 24x7; distribute relief food packets and potable water tankers.

wards.name: Kankarbagh Colony (Ward 44/45)
wards.criticalInfrastructure: Patna Main By-Pass, Medanta Hospital corridor, Post Office
wards.recommendedAction: Check diesel reserves at Pahari sump; pre-position amphibious rescue vehicles.

wards.name: Boring Road & Patliputra (Ward 22)
wards.criticalInfrastructure: AN College, Commercial Banking Hub, Boring Canal Road
wards.recommendedAction: Clear trash grates at Boring canal culverts; caution basement parking operators.

wards.name: Gandhi Maidan & Ashok Rajpath (Ward 30)
wards.criticalInfrastructure: PMCH (Patna Medical College Hospital), Patna University
wards.recommendedAction: Ensure dedicated flood gates to Ganga are operational; safeguard PMCH emergency wards.

wards.name: Digha & Danapur Cantt (Ward 01)
wards.criticalInfrastructure: Digha-Sonpur Bridge, Army Cantonment, Railway Station
wards.recommendedAction: Patrol Ganga flood protection bund (Digha to Danapur); seal minor sand boils.

wards.name: Badshahpur Drain Corridor (Ward 52)
wards.criticalInfrastructure: NH30 By-Pass Flyover, Central Warehouse
wards.recommendedAction: Dredge bottleneck at Punpun discharge canal; deploy mobile generator sets.

name: Kanpur
description: Major industrial city on the south bank of the Ganga; older urban areas plagued by legacy drainage bottlenecks and river backflows.
historicalHotspot: Juhi Underpass, Sisamau Nala, Fazalganj, Govind Nagar

wards.name: Juhi Underpass & Military Camp (Zone 03)
wards.criticalInfrastructure: Juhi Railway Bridge, GT Road connector, Military depot
wards.recommendedAction: Close Juhi underpass to all vehicles immediately when water exceeds 15cm; station police pickets.

wards.name: Sisamau Nala Corridor (Zone 02)
wards.criticalInfrastructure: Hallet Hospital (GSVM Medical College) Access Road
wards.recommendedAction: Divert excess stormwater into secondary bypass conduit; clear culvert debris.

wards.name: Fazalganj & Govind Nagar (Zone 04)
wards.criticalInfrastructure: Fazalganj Fire Station, Industrial Estate, Govind Nagar Station
wards.recommendedAction: Maintain dewatering pumps at Pandu river outfall; alert small manufacturing basements.

wards.name: Civil Lines & Mall Road (Zone 01)
wards.criticalInfrastructure: Kanpur District Magistrate (DM) Office, Police Commissionerate
wards.recommendedAction: Primary District Disaster Management Authority (DDMA) command center node.

wards.name: Kakadeo Coaching Hub (Zone 05)
wards.criticalInfrastructure: Student Hostels (100,000+ students), Coaching Institutes
wards.recommendedAction: Issue advisories to private hostels regarding ground-floor water seepage and power safety.

wards.name: Jajmau & Chakeri (Zone 06)
wards.criticalInfrastructure: Chakeri Air Force Station Link, CETP Treatment Plant
wards.recommendedAction: Prevent industrial effluent backflow into urban drains during high river stages.
